description: Repo-scale (terraform-webapp): a new bastion host's security group must be wired into the app security group's ingress rules, not just created
prompts: Add a bastion (jump) host: a new security_groups.tf resource `aws_security_group.bastion` (ingress 22 from 203.0.113.0/24 - a fictional admin CIDR), and a new bastion.tf with `aws_instance.bastion` (in `aws_subnet.public_a`, using the bastion security group, with a public IP). Creating the bastion alone isn't enough - it needs to actually be able to reach the app instances: add a new ingress rule to the EXISTING `aws_security_group.app` in security_groups.tf allowing port 22 FROM `aws_security_group.bastion`, alongside its existing 8080-from-ALB rule.

test_setup_files.check_bastion_access.py:
import json
import re
import subprocess

init = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'init', '-backend=false', '-input=false'],
                      capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
assert init.returncode == 0, f'terraform init failed:\n{init.stdout}\n{init.stderr}'

validate = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'validate', '-no-color', '-json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(validate.stdout)
assert data.get('valid') is True, f'terraform validate failed: {validate.stdout}\n{validate.stderr}'

bastion_tf = open('bastion.tf', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'aws_instance' in bastion_tf and 'bastion' in bastion_tf, 'aws_instance.bastion not found'
assert re.search(r'security_group_ids\s*=\s*\[aws_security_group\.bastion\.id\]', bastion_tf), (
    'bastion instance must use the bastion security group')

sg = open('security_groups.tf', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'aws_security_group" "bastion"' in sg, 'aws_security_group.bastion not found'

app_block_match = re.search(r'resource\s+"aws_security_group"\s+"app"\s*\{(.*)\}\s*$', sg, re.DOTALL)
assert app_block_match, 'aws_security_group.app not found'
app_block = app_block_match.group(1)

ssh_ingress = re.search(
    r'ingress\s*\{[^}]*from_port\s*=\s*22[^}]*security_groups\s*=\s*\[aws_security_group\.bastion\.id\][^}]*\}',
    app_block, re.DOTALL)
assert ssh_ingress, (
    'aws_security_group.app is missing an ingress rule allowing port 22 from '
    'aws_security_group.bastion - the bastion host exists and is reachable, but nothing '
    'lets it actually reach the app instances, making it useless as a jump host')

print('PASS')

reference_solution.bastion.tf:
resource "aws_instance" "bastion" {
  ami                         = "ami-0123456789abcdef0"
  instance_type               = "t3.micro"
  subnet_id                   = aws_subnet.public_a.id
  vpc_security_group_ids      = [aws_security_group.bastion.id]
  associate_public_ip_address = true
}
